methodology.statistic: unweighted median of fixed-basket observation midpoints
methodology.per_observation: median of platform buys and median of platform sells; midpoint=(buy+sell)/2
methodology.dispersion: median of same-observation maximum minus minimum, separately buy and sell
methodology.limitations: Sampled P2P reference; not time- or volume-weighted, not a close, cash-dollar price, executable quote, confidence interval or forecast. Same platform basket does not establish identical payment methods, trade sizes or executable conditions.

retrieval.note: Parsed and serialized public response, not original HTTP bytes; only bounded evidence is retained.
